name: Yusuhara (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yusuhara town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a ring with a stylised pointed device.
history: Municipal flag of Yusuhara, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Yusuhara town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a ring with a stylised pointed device
